' ---- Sub Workbook_SheetChange ----
Private Sub Workbook_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    Dim area As Range, ar As Range, rw As Range
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim r As Long

    If Sh.Name <> "Expenses" Then Exit Sub
    Set area = Intersect(Target, Sh.Range("C5:H1000"))
    If area Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Set ws = Sh

    On Error GoTo CleanUp
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    For Each ar In area.Areas
        For Each rw In ar.Rows
            r = rw.Row
            If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(ws.Range("C" & r & ":H" & r)) = 0 Then
                ws.Range("A" & r & ":B" & r).ClearContents
                ws.Cells(r, "I").ClearContents
            Else
                If IsEmpty(ws.Cells(r, "A").Value) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, "A").Value = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(ws.Range("A5:A1000")) + 1
                End If
                If IsEmpty(ws.Cells(r, "B").Value) Then ws.Cells(r, "B").Value = Now
                ws.Cells(r, "I").Value = Now
            End If
        Next rw
    Next ar
CleanUp:
    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub

Option Explicit
Private Const FIRST_ROW As Long = 5
Private Const LAST_ROW As Long = 1000

' ---- Sub AddExpense ----
Public Sub AddExpense()
    Dim wsE As Worksheet, wsL As Worksheet, wsS As Worksheet
    Dim r As Long, nextId As Double, amt As Double, cat As String

    Set wsE = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Entry")
    Set wsL = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Expenses")
    Set wsS = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Setup")

    If Not IsDate(wsE.Range("C4").Value) Then
        ShowStatus "Enter a valid date in C4.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    cat = Trim$(CStr(wsE.Range("C5").Value))
    If Len(cat) = 0 Then
        ShowStatus "Choose a category.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIf(wsS.Range("A9:A16"), cat) = 0 Then
        ShowStatus "Category not found on the Setup sheet.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Len(Trim$(CStr(wsE.Range("C6").Value))) = 0 Then
        ShowStatus "Enter a description.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsEmpty(wsE.Range("C7").Value) Or Not IsNumeric(wsE.Range("C7").Value) Then
        ShowStatus "Enter the amount as a number.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    amt = CDbl(wsE.Range("C7").Value)
    If amt <= 0 Then
        ShowStatus "Amount must be greater than zero.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIf(wsS.Range("D9:D13"), CStr(wsE.Range("C8").Value)) = 0 Or _
       Len(CStr(wsE.Range("C8").Value)) = 0 Then
        ShowStatus "Choose a payment method.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If

    r = wsL.Cells(wsL.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row + 1
    If r < FIRST_ROW Then r = FIRST_ROW
    If r > LAST_ROW Then
        ShowStatus "The Expenses sheet is full (row " & LAST_ROW & ").", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    nextId = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(wsL.Range("A" & FIRST_ROW & ":A" & LAST_ROW)) + 1

    On Error GoTo Fail
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    With wsL
        .Cells(r, "A").Value = nextId
        .Cells(r, "B").Value = Now
        .Cells(r, "C").Value = CDate(wsE.Range("C4").Value)
        .Cells(r, "D").Value = cat
        .Cells(r, "E").Value = wsE.Range("C6").Value
        .Cells(r, "F").Value = amt
        .Cells(r, "G").Value = wsE.Range("C8").Value
        .Cells(r, "H").Value = wsE.Range("C9").Value
        .Cells(r, "I").Value = Now
    End With
    Application.EnableEvents = True

    ResetForm
    ShowStatus "Added expense #" & nextId & ": " & Format(amt, "#,##0.00") & " to " & cat & ".", False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    ShowStatus "Could not add the expense: " & Err.Description, True
End Sub

' ---- Sub ClearForm ----
Public Sub ClearForm()
    ResetForm
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Entry").Range("C11").ClearContents
End Sub

' ---- Sub ResetForm ----
Private Sub ResetForm()
    With ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Entry")
        .Range("C4").Formula = "=TODAY()"
        .Range("C5:C9").ClearContents
    End With
End Sub

' ---- Sub ShowStatus ----
Private Sub ShowStatus(ByVal msg As String, ByVal isError As Boolean)
    With ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Entry").Range("C11")
        .Value = msg
        If isError Then
            .Font.Color = RGB(192, 0, 0)
        Else
            .Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        End If
    End With
End Sub

' ---- Sub GenerateReport ----
Public Sub GenerateReport()
    Dim wsS As Worksheet, wsL As Worksheet, wsR As Worksheet
    Dim r As Long, k As Long, m As Long, cnt As Long
    Dim v As Double, found As Boolean
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim usedRow(FIRST_ROW To LAST_ROW) As Boolean

    Set wsS = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Summary")
    Set wsL = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Expenses")

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Report").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    Set wsR = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count))
    wsR.Name = "Report"
    ActiveWindow.DisplayGridlines = False

    With wsR
        .Cells.Font.Name = "Arial"
        .Cells.Font.Size = 10
        .Columns("A").ColumnWidth = 28
        .Columns("B:F").ColumnWidth = 16

        .Range("A1").Value = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Setup").Range("B3").Value & " - Expense Report"
        .Range("A1").Font.Size = 16
        .Range("A1").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A2").Value = "Generated " & Format(Now, "dd mmm yyyy, hh:nn")
        .Range("A2").Font.Italic = True

        ' headline figures (snapshot values)
        .Range("A4").Value = "Total budget":  .Range("B4").Value = wsS.Range("B3").Value
        .Range("A5").Value = "Total spent":   .Range("B5").Value = wsS.Range("B4").Value
        .Range("A6").Value = "Remaining":     .Range("B6").Value = wsS.Range("B5").Value
        .Range("A7").Value = "% of budget used": .Range("B7").Value = wsS.Range("B6").Value
        .Range("A4:A7").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("B4:B6").NumberFormat = "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00);-"
        .Range("B7").NumberFormat = "0.0%"

        ' category breakdown
        .Range("A9").Value = "Spending by category"
        .Range("A9").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A9").Font.Size = 12
        .Range("A10:F10").Value = wsS.Range("A11:F11").Value
        .Range("A11:F19").Value = wsS.Range("A12:F20").Value
        .Range("A10:F10").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A10:F10").Interior.Color = RGB(31, 56, 100)
        .Range("A10:F10").Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        .Range("B11:D19").NumberFormat = "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00);-"
        .Range("E11:E19").NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        .Range("A19:F19").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A19:F19").Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle = xlContinuous
        For r = 11 To 18
            If .Cells(r, "F").Value = "Over budget" Then
                .Cells(r, "F").Font.Color = RGB(192, 0, 0)
                .Cells(r, "F").Font.Bold = True
            ElseIf .Cells(r, "F").Value = "Near limit" Then
                .Cells(r, "F").Font.Color = RGB(191, 120, 0)
            End If
        Next r

        ' five largest expenses
        .Range("A22").Value = "Five largest expenses"
        .Range("A22").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A22").Font.Size = 12
        .Range("A23:E23").Value = Array("Date", "Category", "Description", "Amount", "Payment")
        .Range("A23:E23").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A23:E23").Interior.Color = RGB(31, 56, 100)
        .Range("A23:E23").Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

        Set rng = wsL.Range("F" & FIRST_ROW & ":F" & LAST_ROW)
        cnt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Count(rng)
        r = 24
        For k = 1 To 5
            If k > cnt Then Exit For
            v = Application.WorksheetFunction.Large(rng, k)
            found = False
            For m = FIRST_ROW To LAST_ROW
                If Not found And Not usedRow(m) Then
                    If Not IsEmpty(wsL.Cells(m, "F").Value) Then
                        If IsNumeric(wsL.Cells(m, "F").Value) Then
                            If CDbl(wsL.Cells(m, "F").Value) = v Then
                                usedRow(m) = True
                                found = True
                                .Cells(r, "A").Value = wsL.Cells(m, "C").Value
                                .Cells(r, "B").Value = wsL.Cells(m, "D").Value
                                .Cells(r, "C").Value = wsL.Cells(m, "E").Value
                                .Cells(r, "D").Value = v
                                .Cells(r, "E").Value = wsL.Cells(m, "G").Value
                                r = r + 1
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next m
        Next k
        .Range("A24:A28").NumberFormat = "dd mmm yyyy"
        .Range("A24:A28").HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
        .Range("D24:D28").NumberFormat = "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00);-"
        .Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 34
    End With

    On Error Resume Next
    With wsR.PageSetup
        .Orientation = xlPortrait
        .Zoom = False
        .FitToPagesWide = 1
        .FitToPagesTall = False
        .CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
    End With
    On Error GoTo 0

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    wsR.Activate
    wsR.Range("A1").Select
End Sub

' ---- Sub ExportReportPDF ----
Public Sub ExportReportPDF()
    Dim p As String
    GenerateReport
    p = ExportFolder() & "Expense_Report_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnn") & ".pdf"
    On Error GoTo Fail
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Report").ExportAsFixedFormat Type:=xlTypePDF, Filename:=p, _
        Quality:=xlQualityStandard, IncludeDocProperties:=True, IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
        OpenAfterPublish:=False
    MsgBox "PDF saved:" & vbCrLf & p, vbInformation, "Export complete"
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    MsgBox "Could not export the PDF: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Export failed"
End Sub

' ---- Sub ExportExpensesCSV ----
Public Sub ExportExpensesCSV()
    Dim wsL As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, r As Long, c As Long, f As Integer
    Dim p As String, ln As String, v As Variant, txt As String
    Dim quoted As Boolean

    Set wsL = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Expenses")
    lastRow = wsL.Cells(wsL.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < FIRST_ROW Then
        MsgBox "There are no expenses to export yet.", vbInformation, "Nothing to export"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    p = ExportFolder() & "Expenses_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnn") & ".csv"
    On Error GoTo Fail
    f = FreeFile
    Open p For Output As #f
    For r = 4 To lastRow
        ln = ""
        For c = 1 To 9
            v = wsL.Cells(r, c).Value
            If r > 4 And Not IsEmpty(v) Then
                Select Case c
                    Case 2, 9
                        If IsDate(v) Then v = Format(v, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
                    Case 3
                        If IsDate(v) Then v = Format(v, "yyyy-mm-dd")
                    Case 6
                        If IsNumeric(v) Then v = Replace(Format(CDbl(v), "0.00"), ",", ".")
                End Select
            End If
            quoted = (r = 4) Or c = 4 Or c = 5 Or c = 7 Or c = 8
            txt = CStr(v)
            If quoted Then txt = """" & Replace(txt, """", """""") & """"
            If c > 1 Then ln = ln & ","
            ln = ln & txt
        Next c
        Print #f, ln
    Next r
    Close #f
    MsgBox "CSV saved:" & vbCrLf & p, vbInformation, "Export complete"
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    On Error Resume Next
    Close #f
    MsgBox "Could not export the CSV: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Export failed"
End Sub

' ---- Function ExportFolder ----
Private Function ExportFolder() As String
    Dim p As String
    p = ThisWorkbook.Path
    If Len(p) = 0 Or InStr(p, "://") > 0 Then p = Application.DefaultFilePath
    If Right$(p, 1) <> Application.PathSeparator Then p = p & Application.PathSeparator
    ExportFolder = p
End Function
